scripts.build:pages: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const {mkdirSync,writeFileSync}=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const repo=(process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY?.split('/')[1]||path.basename(process.cwd()).replace(/\s+/g,'-'));const base=process.env.PAGES_BASE_PATH||('/'+repo);const next=process.platform==='win32'?'node_modules\\.bin\\next.cmd':'node_modules/.bin/next';const result=spawnSync(next,['build'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true,env:{...process.env,NEXT_EXPORT:'1',PAGES_BASE_PATH:base}});if(result.status!==0)process.exit(result.status??1);mkdirSync('out',{recursive:true});writeFileSync('out/.nojekyll','');console.log('GitHub Pages export ready in out/');"
scripts.start:fresh: npm run clean && npm run build && next start
scripts.dev:clean: npm run clean && npm run dev
scripts.check:push-policy: git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | node scripts/check-website-essential.mjs
scripts.setup:hooks: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'Git hooks configured at .githooks'
